title: Alpha Website Playbook check bundle
description: The compiled, hashed check bundle the production observer loads and the ticket filer applies (spec/check-bundle.generated.json, built by tests/build-checks.mjs from spec/check-rows.json). Row field names are the contract shared by the playbook, the observer (superbuilders/aeo alpha-site-system) and agent/file-observer-findings.mjs; do not rename them. 1.2 (2026-09-25): channel source-digest, grounding, depth, advisoryReason on rows; depthDefaults and sourceDigest on the bundle. 1.3 (2026-09-25): entitySources, aliases and comparators on the bundle; entitySource and literals on rows; expected.derive.onMissing; dedupeScope campus-registry; comparator registry-coverage.

builtAt.description: ISO timestamp of the build; not part of the hash.

playbookCommit.description: git HEAD when built; not part of the hash.

policySha256.description: policySha256 of spec/policy-bundle.generated.json the rows were compiled against.

sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle without builtAt and playbookCommit; spec/release-manifest.json checkBundleSha256 carries it.

observerInventory.description: Where the observer check names came from (registry/observer-checks.json capturedFrom).

pageFamilies.description: Every value a row's pageFamily may take: real families from spec/page-family-requirements.json map to themselves; pseudo-families map to the families or routes they group.

entitySources.description: Where the observer enumerates the entities a row runs over (1.3, decision 2026-09-25 Matt Barge). hubspot-programs: HubSpot Programs whose type is one of publicTypes and whose website host is one of publicHosts; lifecycle from type; the page fetched at website (trailing slash normalised); fields lists the Program properties the observer needs. map: the growth map API, downstream of HubSpot. pageFamilies on each source lists the row families that default to it.

aliases.description: One id everywhere (1.3): pageCheck maps every tests/page-check.mjs check id that measures a row to that row id (or a list of row ids when one check spans several); pageCheckUnmapped names the rest with the reason. agent/file-found-ticket.mjs writes customFields.requirementId from pageCheck.

comparators.description: spec/observer-comparators.json: every comparator type a row may use with one line of semantics; the observer publishes the list it implements and a conformance test reconciles them.

depthDefaults.description: Row depth defaults by pageFamily (1.2, 2026-09-25): families the observer renders in a browser on both viewports, and families it fetches over HTTP only (the long tail; map-source is a source read). tests/build-checks.mjs fills row.depth from these when a row leaves it out.

sourceDigest.description: The source-digest channel (1.2): owner roles the filer groups source-digest findings under in source-digest.md, and the report file name.

sourceHealth.description: Source ids rows depend on, with the observer provider entity that reports their health and the registry/sources.json entry.

id.description: Requirement id, dotted, unique per row (e.g. campus.hero.header-overlap).

observerCheck.description: The aeo check name that measures this row. One check may feed several rows (viewports, conditions).

pageFamily.description: A key of the bundle's pageFamilies.

entitySource.description: Which entitySources list the row runs over (1.3): hubspot-programs for rows about campus pages (the observer enumerates from HubSpot Programs and fetches website), map otherwise. Defaulted from pageFamily through entitySources.<id>.pageFamilies; default map.

depth.description: How the observer reads the page for this row (1.2): render loads it in a browser on desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 with screenshots; http is one fetch of the route (or a source read) with no rendering. Defaulted from pageFamily through depthDefaults; a row with viewports, a browser dependency or a rendered comparator is always render.

lifecycleStates.description: Campus states the row applies to; empty when the row is not lifecycle-bound.

element.description: spec/campus-page-field-map.json element key, or a page-level pseudo-element (page.*, head.*, map.*, event.*, observer.*, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, locations.directory).

viewports.description: Rendered rows only: which viewports the row is measured on (desktop 1440x1000, mobile 390x844).

when.description: Condition that selects this row among rows sharing an observerCheck.

expected.description: Either { literal } or { derive: { source, field, transform, onMissing } }. 1.3: a row with literals publishes them at row.literals and, on a derive row, mirrored at expected.literal next to the derive (the observer reads them there through rules.literalValue).

source.description: A sourceHealth id, or 'registry' for a playbook spec or registry file named in field.

onMissing.description: 1.3: what an in-scope entity with no entry in the derived-from registry means. finding: a finding of this row with missingExpectation true, titled no approved <literals.thing> recorded for <state> campus <name>, filed Missing Info to the row ownerRole (the registry owner) with literals.missingAsk. skip (default): no expectation, nothing measured.

literals.description: Fixed values the observer and the filer read for this row (1.3): missingAsk (the exact ask filed with a missingExpectation finding), missingThing (the noun in the missing-expectation title: no approved <missingThing> recorded for <state> campus <name>), launchWords (the vision pass word list on the primary campus visuals), assetPatterns (known launch-era asset paths), registries (the coverage row: file, keyPath, requiredWhen.type, ownerRole, ticketClass, thing, ask per registry). Mirrored at expected.literal.

detectAbove.description: Below the filing threshold the observer still records the measurement above this value as telemetry.

status.description: enforced rows dispatch tickets; advisory rows are measured and reported, never filed. The builder sets advisory on any enforced row whose grounding is none (promotion rule, docs/observer-requirements.md) and says so in advisoryReason.

advisoryReason.description: Why the builder set status advisory on a row the source declares enforced (grounding none).

channel.description: ticket rows enter the website queue. source-digest rows (1.2) are source-versus-source comparisons that are not website defects: the filer never files them and writes them to source-digest.md grouped by owner role. loop-health rows go to the observer owner and suppress the rows they name; they never enter the website queue.

ownerRole.description: The intake owner role for the ticket class (spec/intake-policy.json), or the row's override.

dedupeScope.description: page, template, program, event, site, or campus-registry (1.3: one ticket per campus and registry for the coverage row).

clearAfterRuns.description: Runs the check must clear before the filer resolves the ticket (default 2).

gracePeriodHours.description: Hours after the source change before a finding may file (default 0).

requireConsecutiveRuns.description: Consecutive failing runs before a finding may file (default 1; 2 for timeouts).

sourceHealthDependency.description: sourceHealth ids; an unhealthy source suppresses the row's findings.

suppresses.description: loop-health rows: which rows are suppressed while this finding is open.

exemptionsRef.description: Registry file (or files, since bundle 1.1) the observer and the filer must read for named exceptions; each is a repository path, optionally followed by a space and the key inside the file (registry/campus-packets.json interimPolicy, registry/campus-leadership.json groups).

decisionPending.description: APEX ticket id of the decision that can change this row; the row carries the recommended value until then.

grounding.description: What grounds the rule (1.2; the 2026-09-15 precedence: a named leadership decision, then a source-of-truth system, then a visually approved exemplar, then a repeated complaint). kind none means nobody has grounded it yet: the row is measured, never filed.

ref.description: Where the grounding lives: a decisions.md row or plan section, a spec or registry path and key, an exemplar URL, or the complaint (ticket, incident or findings document).

key.description: Slash-separated path inside the file, e.g. rules/site.layout.viewport or states/Open/campus.hero.identity.

requirement.description: Coarse requirement id from spec/observer-check-map.json for the observerCheck.

replacedBy.description: Row id that now covers the intent, or null.
